items.text: Root cause identified: the CLI binary is committed as `cli/pm` but the scenario-auditor rule at `required_layout.go:112-116` expects `cli/prompt-manager` (matching the scenario name). Other scenarios follow this convention correctly (e.g., `swarm-manager/cli/swarm-manager`, `scenario-auditor/cli/scenario-auditor`).

The `install.sh` already correctly passes `--name "prompt-manager"` to cli-core, so the installed binary in `~/.vrooli/bin/` is already named correctly. Only the in-repo binary at `cli/pm` has the wrong name.

items.topic: How to fix the binary naming
items.context: The `cli/pm` binary (8.3MB ELF Go executable) is tracked in git. We need `cli/prompt-manager` instead. The binary can be rebuilt from the Go source in `cli/` (main.go, app.go).

options.label: Rebuild with correct name via `go build -o prompt-manager .`
options.rationale: Clean approach — produces a fresh binary with the correct name. Ensures the binary matches current source. Takes ~5 seconds.

options.label: Simply rename: `git mv cli/pm cli/prompt-manager`
options.rationale: Fastest fix, preserves git history. But the binary may be stale relative to current source code.

items.notes: Pre-selected option A since rebuilding is trivial and ensures the binary matches current source.

items.topic: Should we add the binary name to .gitignore?
items.context: Currently `cli/pm` is tracked in git (8.3MB). Other scenarios also track their CLI binaries (e.g., swarm-manager tracks both `swarm-manager` and `swarm-manager-cli`). Large binaries in git are suboptimal but this is the established pattern.

options.label: Follow existing pattern — track cli/prompt-manager in git
options.rationale: Consistent with other scenarios. No process changes needed. Developers get the binary without building.

options.label: Add to .gitignore, build on demand via install.sh
options.rationale: Cleaner git history, smaller repo. But breaks the pattern and requires all devs to build before use.

items.notes: Pre-selected to maintain consistency with other scenarios.

items.text: This plan appears ready for execution. All dimensions score 2+ and the fix is straightforward: rebuild the binary with the correct name, remove the old one, and verify. Consider reviewing and queuing.
